_comment: Every *:allow escape-hatch annotation on a data-integrity lint guard (lint-lua:allow, pcall:allow, catch:allow, lint-webpack-cache:allow, lint-test-grounding:allow) MUST be enumerated here, or lint-allow-manifest.mjs FAILS. Adding an entry is a deliberate, reviewable act requiring ORCHESTRATOR/OWNER approval BEFORE the PR opens (memory: lint-allows-are-escalations; the PR #75 incident). The manifest must match reality EXACTLY — a removed annotation must also be removed here, in the same reviewed commit. Counts are per (file, marker). An approver of "PENDING ADJUDICATION" marks an allow the implementer could NOT ground and is escalating for the orchestrator/owner to either ground (replace with a citation) or ratify.
